question: What rejuvenating transformation occurs through six months of repeated practice?
premises: The practice is performed for six months.
The practice is repeated and sustained.
Even an old person becomes youthful.
inference: Six months of repeated practice rejuvenates even an old person.
uncertainties: The form taruṇā āyate may reflect non-standard sandhi or spelling.
plain_english: Through six months of repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
